Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-case-specific-indication-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-case-specific-indication-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
triage Triage and PrioritizationUse of the AI system to support urgency assessment, prioritization, or routing.
screening ScreeningUse of the AI system to identify individuals or findings that may require further assessment.
second-opinion Second OpinionUse of the AI system to provide an additional assessment alongside a human clinical assessment.
diagnostic-support Diagnostic SupportUse of the AI system to support the identification or assessment of a diagnosis.
treatment-planning Treatment PlanningUse of the AI system to support selection, planning, or adaptation of treatment.
prognosis Prognostic PredictionUse of the AI system to estimate a future clinical outcome, risk, or disease course.
